description:
Implement GPU (HIP) batch encoding as a backend behind the canonical encoding surface of epic ae03bcd0: the allocation-free single/workspace/batch encoding APIs (issue 8f68699b) and field-generic traits::block encoders of bch-api-design, with the packed binary BitVec/BitMatrix specializations. Behavioral equivalence with the CPU paths follows the shared conformance suites (backend-behavioral-equivalence); deterministic seeded execution and tested fallback selection apply.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: GPU batch encoding implements the canonical encoding interfaces with bit-identical results to the CPU reference across the shared conformance suite.
- [hard] REQ-02: Capability detection selects a tested CPU fallback when the GPU is unavailable, and benchmark receipts document the crossover against the optimized CPU path.
title: GPU batch encoding behind the canonical encoding interfaces
